definitions: A flattened fold in cloth that is sewn or stitched into place.
A surgical procedure to reduce the size of an organ or to remove fatty tissue.
Food, especially sweets and pastry, eaten by children at school.
A position in gymnastics or diving where the knees are drawn up to the chest.
examples: She sewed a small tuck in the sleeve.
He went to the clinic for a tummy tuck.
The school shop sells plenty of tuck.
The diver performed a somersault in a tight tuck.
